translation: The method is to massage the broken bone with both hands, push and pull to restore it to position, then press the injured place with the fingertips; if there is no misaligned or fallen bone, wrap it in a bamboo curtain (竹簾), and every morning take Zhenggu Zijin Dan (Bone-Setting Purple-Gold Pill, 正骨紫金丹). After three days, open the curtain and look; if there is a place that is not level, then pinch the sinew knots to make them smooth and level, apply Wanling Gao (Myriad-Efficacy Plaster, 萬靈膏), and still wrap it in the bamboo curtain. <ins>Zhenggu Zijin Dan</ins> (seen in the injury of the vertex bone) <ins>Wanling Gao</ins> (seen in the injury of the vertex bone).
